explication: Gortex is a persistent code-intelligence engine for AI agents and IDEs. The principal workflow is: an agent, IDE, or CLI request reaches the daemon/MCP surface; indexed repositories are parsed, semantically enriched, and stored as a graph; query and search engines retrieve, traverse, rerank, and return grounded code intelligence. The graph also preserves cross-repository contracts, impact analysis, overlays, agent hooks, and review capabilities. Some subsystem links reflect README-documented behavior because only selected source excerpts were available.
